status_summary: On 2025-08-06 VA announced it was ending collective bargaining agreements for most bargaining-unit employees represented by five unions, citing Executive Order 14251, which added VA to the agencies excluded from federal labor-management relations programs; contracts for about 4,000 police officers, firefighters and security guards were kept. A federal district court in Rhode Island issued a preliminary injunction on 2026-03-13 requiring VA to reinstate its contract with AFGE. On 2026-05-16 the First Circuit (No. 26-1321) denied VA's request to stay that injunction but stayed the parts of a district enforcement order that required compliance with the agreement and continued grievance processing. After the district court granted a further motion to enforce on 2026-08-07, the First Circuit on 2026-10-02 (Nos. 26-1321 and 26-1904) stayed that enforcement order, which according to press reports appears to let VA treat the agreement as lapsed while the appeal of the injunction continues.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14251 signed, excluding certain agencies, including VA, from federal labor-management relations programs.
VA announced it had ended collective bargaining agreements for most bargaining-unit employees, keeping contracts for about 4,000 police, firefighters and security guards.
The U.S. District Court in Rhode Island issued a preliminary injunction requiring VA to reinstate its contract with AFGE.

The First Circuit (No. 26-1321) denies VA's motion to stay the preliminary injunction reinstating the AFGE agreement, but stays the parts of the district court's enforcement order requiring compliance with the agreement and continued processing of grievances and arbitrations.

timeline.event: The court granted a motion to enforce the injunction, rejecting VA's July 2026 notice of re-termination effective 2026-08-08; reporting said the contract remains in effect.

On VA's second stay motion (Nos. 26-1321 and 26-1904), the First Circuit stays the district court's August 2026 enforcement order, finding it likely modified the injunction by deciding whether the agreement was automatically extended (disposition as reported by Government Executive).
